findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There was a dish on the handwashing sink in the back area and a dish in it. CORRECTED- This was discussed with the PIC and both items were removed from the handwashing sink. Ensure that staff are educated that handwashing sinks should ONLY be used for the intended purpose of handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: There were at least ten ants on the counter to the left of the drive through window. Shown to the PIC and the facility mentioned contacting EcoLab to come provide treatment to the premise. Ensure to throughly clean countertops that are exposed to splatter and dripping syrups to prevent the presence of insects and also accumulated debris.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: The walk-in freezer has a significant accumulation of ice and frost on the fan units, walls, ceiling, floor, and boxes of food. This was discussed with the PIC, who stated that the gasket of the freezer door needs replaced and should arrive by Wednesday. Ensure that the issue is repaired and that all frost and ice is removed.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following areas were observed accumulated with debris:
- The inside cabinet space of the fry station contained a significant amount of debris such as salt, discarded fries, etc.
- The inside cabinet space of the ice cream machine was observed with a significant amount of spilled syrup
- The top of the inside of the tea machine, where the tea is dispensed from has an accumulation of residue on it.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The front handwashing sink has an accumulation of soil residue in the caulking. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that this handwashing sink is resealed and made to be smooth and easily cleanable.
Additionally, the facility could use some cleaning along the coffee station. Floors underneath coffee equipment were observed with splatter and food debris. Ensure that physical facilities are cleaned as frequent as necessary.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: There was dried ice cream residue on the top surface of the ice cream machine. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that non-food contact surfaces of the ice cream machine are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.
